items.title: Refine classifyReproFirstRequirement to material-code bug/feature + safety net
items.context: packages/main/src/core/repro-evidence-binding-gate.ts: change classifyReproFirstRequirement so required = (story.type in {bug,feature} AND the checklist declares >=1 material-code file, judged by reusing classifyReviewAssuranceFloorPath from review-assurance-floor.ts) OR (priority high|critical AND a CODE_VERIFIABLE_RISK_CATEGORIES signal hit). Otherwise required=false (reason e.g. not_code_verifiable_or_no_material). REMOVE the bare bug_story rule and the bare file_declarations rule. Do NOT change resolveReproFirstPreflightMode, the off/warn/enforce modes, the blocking math (resultFor), or the bypass reasonCode. If importing classifyReviewAssuranceFloorPath causes a circular import, extract a minimal shared material-path helper instead.

happy.desc: classifyReproFirstRequirement({type:"bug"}, checklist-with-material-code-files) returns required=true with reason material_bug_or_feature -> confirms material bug is classified as repro-required; WHY: primary happy-path for the refined conjunction (type=bug AND material-code files)

classifyReproFirstRequirement({type:"feature"}, checklist-with-material-code-files) returns required=true with reason material_bug_or_feature -> confirms material feature is classified as repro-required; WHY: primary happy-path for the second type in the conjunction

classifyReproFirstRequirement({type:"bug",priority:"high",riskSignals:[{category:"State Machine/Gate"}]}, no-file-checklist) returns required=true via high_risk_code_verifiable -> confirms the safety-net path still fires for high-risk code-verifiable bugs even without material files; WHY: safety net must survive the refactor

edge.desc: classifyReproFirstRequirement({type:"bug"}, checklist-with-only-docs-files) returns required=false -> docs-only bug is NOT repro-required because .md files are not material code per classifyReviewAssuranceFloorPath; WHY: this is the core over-reach the story fixes
classifyReproFirstRequirement({type:"feature"}, checklist-with-only-docs-files) returns required=false -> docs-only feature is NOT repro-required; WHY: symmetric edge to docs-only bug

classifyReproFirstRequirement({type:"refactor"}, checklist-with-material-code-files) returns required=false -> material refactor is NOT repro-required because type is not bug|feature; WHY: ensures the type predicate is respected
classifyReproFirstRequirement({type:"chore"}, checklist-with-material-code-files) returns required=false -> chore is NOT repro-required even with material files; WHY: chore is outside bug|feature
classifyReproFirstRequirement({type:"bug"}, empty-checklist-or-no-files) returns required=false -> no-file bug is NOT repro-required; WHY: the bare bug_story rule is removed

classifyReproFirstRequirement({type:"feature",priority:"medium"}, no-file-checklist-with-high-risk-signal) returns required=false -> medium-priority with risk signals is NOT repro-required; WHY: safety net requires BOTH high/critical priority AND risk signals
classifyReproFirstRequirement(null, null) returns required=false with bypass_eligible reason -> null/missing story+checklist gracefully returns not-required; WHY: defensive null handling

adversarial.desc: No circular import between repro-evidence-binding-gate.ts and review-assurance-floor.ts (or a shared helper is extracted) -> import resolves without error at module load time; WHY: the story explicitly warns about circular import risk when reusing classifyReviewAssuranceFloorPath

resolveReproFirstPreflightMode, resultFor blocking math, and bypass reasonCode are unchanged (diff shows no modifications to those functions/types) -> mechanics outside the classifier are NOT touched; WHY: story explicitly forbids changing mode/blocking/bypass behavior

items.userSees: `lattice story_create` for a docs-only bug / refactor / chore no longer prints the Repro-first STORY_INTAKE preflight warning; a type=bug|feature declaring a material-code file still does. `npm --prefix packages/main run build` is clean.

items.title: Update the classification smokes + add the red/spike regression
items.context: Update packages/main/src/tasks/repro-evidence-binding-dev-gate-smoke.ts (and repro-first-candidate-smoke.ts if it asserts classification) to the refined behavior, and add the red/spike regression assertions: classifyReproFirstRequirement returns required=false for {docs-only bug, docs feature, material refactor, chore-with-material, no-file bug} and required=true for {material bug, material feature, high/critical+code-verifiable-risk}. Run the smokes green; npm test green.

happy.desc: Run npx tsx packages/main/src/tasks/repro-evidence-binding-dev-gate-smoke.ts -> all existing assertions pass (updated to match refined classification) AND new classification assertions pass; final line is "repro evidence binding dev gate smoke passed"; WHY: the primary green-pass of the updated smoke proves the classifier + gate integration works end-to-end
Run npm test -> full test suite green including the updated smoke; WHY: ensures no regressions in the broader test surface

edge.desc: The smoke contains explicit assertions for EACH of the 5 required=false cases (docs-only bug, docs feature, material refactor, chore-with-material, no-file bug) and EACH of the 3 required=true cases (material bug, material feature, high/critical+code-verifiable-risk) -> all 8 classification vectors are covered; WHY: the checklist context names these exact cases as the required regression vectors

The smoke existing test "IDEA->PLAN no-file checklist passes without binding" still passes -> the no-file-declarations bypass still works with the refined classifier; WHY: regression guard on the existing non-code story path

The smoke existing test "PLAN->DEV bug-story missing binding diagnostic uses classifier reason" is updated or removed per the new classification (a no-file bug is no longer required) -> no stale assertion references the removed bug_story reason; WHY: the bare bug_story reason code is removed from the classifier

adversarial.desc: Red-test regression: flipping any one of the 4 over-reach cases (e.g. making a docs-only bug required=true, or exempting a material bug to required=false, or exempting material feature, or re-requiring no-file bug) causes at least one smoke assertion to FAIL -> the smoke is sensitive to classification regressions; WHY: this is the red/spike regression the story validates by; each flip must break a specific assertion
repro-first-candidate-smoke.ts (if it touches classification) still passes -> no side-effect on the companion smoke file; WHY: the checklist context mentions updating it if it asserts classification

items.userSees: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/repro-evidence-binding-dev-gate-smoke.js` prints its pass line; the red/spike regression (docs/refactor/chore/no-file -> not required; material bug/feature + high-risk -> required) is asserted.
